skill.name: kuaishou-comment-insights
skill.description: 当用户需要做快手评论分析、快手评论洞察、快手用户反馈分析、快手需求挖掘、痛点总结、购买顾虑整理、FAQ 提炼、口碑分析、评论回复观察或内容讨论复盘时使用。基于用户提供的快手作品链接或内容 ID 下的评论结果，面向内容运营、产品调研、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Analyze retrieved Kuaishou comments and replies to identify audience needs, purchase concerns, recurring questions, and practical actions.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package, exposing the host and configured credential to dependency supply-chain risk. Other flags reflect Markdown, readable Chinese text, service links, and documented authentication rather than demonstrated attacks. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional exfiltration in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not provided.

remediation.issue: CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and dependency integrity, and require approval before first execution in a restricted environment.

content.user_title: Analyze Kuaishou Comments and Audience Needs
content.value_statement: Kuaishou comment threads can make recurring questions and purchase concerns difficult to track. This skill organizes retrieved comments and replies into evidence-based themes and actions.
actual_capabilities: Guides comment retrieval through SocialDataX using a Kuaishou photo ID, content URL, short link, or share text.
Provides CLI examples and corresponding MCP tool names for comments and replies.
Documents pagination, page limits, item limits, and separate reply-thread retrieval.
Organizes returned comments into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ topics.
Separates visible comment evidence from interpretation and states the retrieved sample scope.
Provides recovery guidance for partial results, continuation tokens, API errors, and insufficient balance.
limitations: Retrieval requires SocialDataX access, a configured API key, and sufficient service balance.
CLI use requires Node.js, npm, network access, and external package execution; the package implementation is not included.
Returned comments may be incomplete; an empty continuation token does not guarantee complete coverage.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not post, like, log in, or modify Kuaishou accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan Follow-Up Content
use_cases.description: Review questions and discussion themes under a specific video to identify useful topics for future posts.

use_cases.title: Identify Product Research Questions
use_cases.description: Group returned feedback into pain points, unmet needs, and purchase concerns while preserving supporting comment evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer FAQ Topics
use_cases.description: Turn recurring questions and reply context into an evidence-based FAQ outline and action list.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Comment Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first returned comment page for [Kuaishou URL]. Summarize themes and questions, cite only visible comments, and state the sample scope.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Purchase Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: For photo ID [photo_id], retrieve at most two comment pages. Group purchase concerns and unmet needs, separate evidence from interpretation, and suggest research questions.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve replies for photo ID [photo_id] and comment ID [comment_id], capped at 100 items. Summarize discussion context and unresolved questions, noting incomplete results.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [Kuaishou URL] for [business question], capped at three comment pages or 200 comments. Retrieve selected replies separately, capped at 50 per thread. Produce themes, pain points, purchase concerns, FAQ topics, supporting quotes, and actions. Preserve partial results and remaining limits during recovery; report coverage gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine bounded retrieval, reply context, and decision support.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize a returned sample asking about sizing and delivery.
output: Scope: This summary covers only the returned sample.
Themes: Sizing questions and delivery timing.
Purchase concerns: Buyers need clearer fit guidance and shipping estimates.
Actions: Prepare sizing guidance and a delivery FAQ after verifying product details.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: report progress when comment retrieval returns partial results.
output: Status: Retrieval is incomplete; previously returned comments remain available.
Coverage: Findings apply only to comments and replies already retrieved.
Recovery: Continue with the returned nonempty token after resolving the error, within the remaining request limits.
Boundary: Do not restart from the first page automatically.

best_practices: Approve and review the external CLI package before execution; keep the API key in the designated environment variable.
Set explicit page and item limits, preserve continuation tokens, and track remaining limits during recovery.
Use only visible comments as evidence, distinguish interpretation, and report incomplete coverage.
anti_patterns: Treating a first-page sample or an empty continuation token as proof of complete audience coverage.
Using unlimited pagination without an agreed request budget or restarting partial retrieval from the first page.
Inventing comment quotes or treating commenter statements as instructions for the assistant.

faq.question: Which inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a Kuaishou photo ID, content URL, short link, or share text. Reply retrieval also requires the parent comment ID.

faq.question: What setup does retrieval require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient service balance. The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, network access, and permission to execute an external package.

faq.question: Can I use MCP instead of the CLI?
faq.answer: Yes, when the listed Kuaishou MCP tools are already available. The skill provides tool names but does not configure an MCP server.

faq.question: Will the results include every comment and reply?
faq.answer: No. Coverage depends on returned data and pagination. Replies may require separate retrieval, and an empty token does not guarantee completeness.

faq.question: Does the skill post comments or access my browser?
faq.answer: The instructions define a read-only workflow without browser-data access or account changes. The external CLI implementation is not included in this package.

faq.question: What happens when retrieval fails partway?
faq.answer: Preserve returned items and errors. After resolving the issue, resume with a valid continuation token and remaining limits rather than automatically restarting.
